method.test: two-group OLS per feature on available samples (pooled variance, df = nA+nB-2), then limma eBayes shrinkage (fitFDist moments, trend=FALSE, robust=FALSE; Python port) + BH — the paper's lmFit/eBayes/topTable chain
method.rtTrend: per-sample lowess vs RT, frac 0.5, subtracted (normalize_by_feature_property lowess branch)

definitions.eligible: >= 2 positive detections in BOTH groups (raw counts)
definitions.log2FoldChange: mean(analyzed groupB) - mean(analyzed groupA); positive = higher in groupB
definitions.log2MedianRatio: median(analyzed groupB) - median(analyzed groupA); the analyzed scale is log2, so this is a log-ratio; robust companion to log2FoldChange
definitions.groupAMedian/groupBMedian: medians of the analyzed (normalized) values, not raw intensities
definitions.bhFdr: Benjamini-Hochberg over features with a pValue; null when untestable
definitions.bhSignificantCount: features with bhFdr < 0.05 and |log2FoldChange| > 1 (the counts below that key use this rule)
definitions.provenance: default normalization/test reproduce the TopPICR paper's downstream chain as a Python port (MSnSet.utils log2_zero_center, normalizeByGlob medpolish, normalize_by_feature_property lowess; limma eBayes BH) — state the port, not R limma identity, in publications
